title: Natural release workspace job running-state and overlap diagnostic
prompt:
Use only CodeGG `test`, `job`, `read`, and `write`. Do not inspect or run the private verifier, use bash, submit other tests, or modify Rust source.

Submit exactly one `test` job with `cargo test --offline --locked --release --workspace`. Copy the exact `job_id` returned by that submission. If no ID is returned, stop and report the typed failure.

Immediately call `job` with action `status` using that exact ID. If it reports `running`, read `fixture/README.md` and `fixture/contract.json`, then write `fixture/CONTINUATION.md` with the observed job ID, its running status, current phase, and one concrete next dependent Rust edit. Poll the same exact ID until terminal (at most five polls total). If the first status is already terminal, do not resubmit; report that no running interval was observable. A failed test still requires its exact terminal status. Never guess an ID or use a task run ID.

After terminal, report the exact ID, ordered statuses, whether productive work occurred while it was running, and stop. This isolates job running-state visibility and overlap; it is not H007 qualification.
